# Harris

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves P13](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves P19](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0019)</sub>

- **Family:** [Samuel](../character/samuel.md) (relative)

## Appearance

Harris is a dashing young person with big, rolling brown eyes and an extensive, bewildering smile. She wears a huge, drooping pompadour and dresses with exceeding smartness, adorned with several bangle bracelets that glitter, rattle, and tinkle when she moves her hands.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves P7](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0007)_

## History

Harris worked as a clerk at Lawson's store. When [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) attempted to buy a dress for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), Harris's presence made him flustered and unable to complete his purchase.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves P2](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXV.
